method: Independent full physical-word reconstruction of all highest weights, spin ladders and necessary contraction rows; exact rational row combination and positive-definite LDL certificate.
scope: Universal exclusion of dimension-two third-order anticoherent subspaces of spin15/2, including arbitrary complex bases.

positiveDefiniteRowCertificate.conclusion: The exact linear combination of necessary equations is a strictly positive functional on every nonzero positive semidefinite invariant moment. Thus the normalized moment cannot exist.

statement: K(15,3)=1: no dimension-two third-order AC subspace exists, and an exact four-component third-order state supplies dimension one.
